passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, “Take vengeance on the Midianites.
Do this for the Israelites.
After you do this, you will be gathered to your people.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ נְקֹ֗ם נִקְמַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֖ת הַמִּדְיָנִ֑ים אַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵ֥ף אֶל־ עַמֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: So Moses told the people, “Arm some of your men for war, that they may go against the Midianites and execute the LORD’s vengeance on them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses spoke to the people.
He gave them a command.
He said, “Choose men from among you.
Prepare these men for battle.
Send them to fight against the Midianites.
They will carry out the LORD’s vengeance on the Midianites.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ הָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר הֵחָלְצ֧וּ מֵאִתְּכֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וְיִהְיוּ֙ עַל־ מִדְיָ֔ן לָתֵ֥ת נִקְמַת־ יְהוָ֖ה בְּמִדְיָֽן׃

passages.text: Send into battle a thousand men from each tribe of Israel.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites.
God said to send men into battle.
Moses spoke to the people.
Moses told the people to send men for war.
Moses said, "Send a thousand men from each tribe of Israel."
Each tribe must send one thousand men.
All the tribes of Israel must send men to the army.
passages.original: אֶ֚לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה לְכֹל֙ מַטּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תִּשְׁלְח֖וּ לַצָּבָֽא׃

passages.text: So a thousand men were recruited from each tribe of Israel—twelve thousand armed for war.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
He told them to prepare for war.
Israel had twelve tribes.
Each tribe gave one thousand men.
The people chose these men for battle.
In total, they chose twelve thousand men.
These men were ready and armed for war.
passages.original: וַיִּמָּֽסְרוּ֙ מֵאַלְפֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֖לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֑ה שְׁנֵים־ עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא׃

passages.text: And Moses sent the thousand from each tribe into battle, along with Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest, who took with him the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for signaling.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses sent one thousand men from each tribe into battle.
Phinehas was the son of Eleazar.
Phinehas was a priest.
Moses sent Phinehas with the soldiers into battle.
Phinehas took the holy vessels with him.
Phinehas also took the trumpets for signaling.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶ֥לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֖ה לַצָּבָ֑א אֹ֠תָם וְאֶת־ פִּ֨ינְחָ֜ס בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ לַצָּבָ֔א וּכְלֵ֥י הַקֹּ֛דֶשׁ וַחֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַתְּרוּעָ֖ה בְּיָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then they waged war against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites went to war against Midian.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
The Israelites obeyed the LORD’s command.
They killed every male in Midian.
passages.original: וַֽיִּצְבְּאוּ֙ עַל־ מִדְיָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל־ זָכָֽר׃

passages.text: Among the slain were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites fought against Midian.
They killed the kings of Midian.
The kings were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
There were five kings of Midian.
The Israelites killed them in battle.
They also killed Balaam.
Balaam was the son of Beor.
They killed Balaam with the sword.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ מַלְכֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן הָרְג֣וּ עַל־ חַלְלֵיהֶ֗ם אֶת־ אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־ רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־ צ֤וּר וְאֶת־ חוּר֙ וְאֶת־ רֶ֔בַע חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן וְאֵת֙ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ בְּע֔וֹר הָרְג֖וּ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: The Israelites captured the Midianite women and their children, and they plundered all their herds, flocks, and goods.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites fought against the Midianites.
God had commanded Moses to lead the Israelites.
The Israelites captured the women of Midian.
They also captured the children of Midian.
The Israelites took all the herds of the Midianites.
They took all the flocks of the Midianites.
They plundered all the goods of the Midianites.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁבּ֧וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ נְשֵׁ֥י מִדְיָ֖ן וְאֶת־ טַפָּ֑ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ בְּהֶמְתָּ֧ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ מִקְנֵהֶ֛ם וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֵילָ֖ם בָּזָֽזוּ׃

passages.text: Then they burned all the cities where the Midianites had lived, as well as all their encampments, and carried away all the plunder and spoils, both people and animals.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites attacked the Midianites.
They burned every city where the Midianites had lived.
They also burned all the Midianite encampments.
The Israelites took all the plunder from the Midianites.
They took all the spoils from the Midianites.
They carried away people as part of the spoils.
They also carried away animals as part of the spoils.
passages.original: וְאֵ֤ת כָּל־ עָרֵיהֶם֙ בְּמ֣וֹשְׁבֹתָ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ טִֽירֹתָ֑ם שָׂרְפ֖וּ בָּאֵֽשׁ׃ וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַשָּׁלָ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הַמַּלְק֑וֹחַ בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָֽה׃

passages.text: They brought the captives, spoils, and plunder to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of Israel at the camp on the plains of Moab, by the Jordan across from Jericho.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites had captives, spoils, and plunder.
They brought the captives, spoils, and plunder to Moses.
They brought them to Eleazar the priest.
They brought them to the congregation of Israel.
They brought everything to the camp.
The camp was on the plains of Moab.
The plains of Moab were by the Jordan River.
The camp was across from Jericho.
passages.original: וַיָּבִ֡אוּ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁה֩ וְאֶל־ אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־ הַשְּׁבִ֧י וְאֶת־ הַמַּלְק֛וֹחַ וְאֶת־ הַשָּׁלָ֖ל אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה אֶל־ עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the leaders of the congregation went to meet them outside the camp.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Eleazar was the priest of Israel.
The leaders of the congregation were important men among the people of Israel.
Moses, Eleazar, and all the leaders went out together.
They went to meet the soldiers who were returning.
They met them outside the camp.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכָל־ נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לִקְרָאתָ֑ם אֶל־ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

passages.text: But Moses was angry with the officers of the army—the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds—who were returning from the battle.
passages.sermon:
Moses was a leader of Israel.
The officers of the army returned from battle.
These officers included commanders of thousands.
These officers also included commanders of hundreds.
Moses became angry with these officers.
passages.original: וַיִּקְצֹ֣ף מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַ֖ל פְּקוּדֵ֣י הֶחָ֑יִל שָׂרֵ֤י הָאֲלָפִים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַמֵּא֔וֹת הַבָּאִ֖ים מִצְּבָ֥א הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: “Have you spared all the women?” he asked them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses spoke to the army officers.
Moses asked them a question.
Moses said, “Did you let all the women live?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה הַֽחִיִּיתֶ֖ם כָּל־ נְקֵבָֽה׃

passages.text: “Look, these women caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor, so that the plague struck the congregation of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses spoke to the army officers.
Moses said, “These women caused trouble for Israel.”
Balaam gave these women advice.
The women led the sons of Israel to be unfaithful to the LORD.
This happened at Peor.
Because of this, the LORD sent a plague.
The plague struck the congregation of the LORD.
passages.original: הֵ֣ן הֵ֜נָּה הָי֨וּ לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֔ם לִמְסָר־ מַ֥עַל בַּיהוָ֖ה עַל־ דְּבַר־ פְּע֑וֹר וַתְּהִ֥י הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה בַּעֲדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So now, kill all the boys, as well as every woman who has had relations with a man, but spare for yourselves every girl who has never had relations with a man.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the soldiers of Israel.
He gave them a command from the LORD.
He said, "Kill every boy among the captives."
He said, "Kill every woman who has had relations with a man."
He said, "Spare every girl who has never had relations with a man."
He said, "Keep these girls alive for yourselves."
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִרְג֥וּ כָל־ זָכָ֖ר בַּטָּ֑ף וְכָל־ אִשָּׁ֗ה יֹדַ֥עַת אִ֛ישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּ֥ב זָכָ֖ר הֲרֹֽגוּ׃ וְכֹל֙ הַטַּ֣ף בַּנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר הַחֲי֖וּ לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: All of you who have killed a person or touched the dead are to remain outside the camp for seven days. On the third day and the seventh day you are to purify both yourselves and your captives.
passages.sermon:
The Lord gave instructions to the Israelites after battle.
He spoke to those who killed a person.
He spoke to those who touched a dead body.
You must stay outside the camp for seven days.
On the third day, you must purify yourselves.
On the third day, you must purify your captives.
On the seventh day, you must purify yourselves again.
On the seventh day, you must purify your captives again.
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֗ם חֲנ֛וּ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כֹּל֩ הֹרֵ֨ג נֶ֜פֶשׁ וְכֹ֣ל׀ נֹגֵ֣עַ בֶּֽחָלָ֗ל תִּֽתְחַטְּא֞וּ בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י אַתֶּ֖ם וּשְׁבִיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: And purify every garment and leather good, everything made of goat’s hair, and every article of wood.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to the people after a battle.
He gave instructions from God.
He told them to purify certain items.
Purify every garment.
Purify every leather item.
Purify everything made of goat’s hair.
Purify every article made of wood.
passages.original: וְכָל־ בֶּ֧גֶד וְכָל־ כְּלִי־ ע֛וֹר וְכָל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּ֖ים וְכָל־ כְּלִי־ עֵ֑ץ תִּתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃ס

passages.text: Then Eleazar the priest said to the soldiers who had gone into battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses: Only the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead— everything that can withstand the fire—must be put through the fire, and it will be clean. But it must still be purified with the water of purification. And everything that cannot withstand the fire must pass through the water.
passages.sermon:
Eleazar was the priest.
He spoke to the soldiers.
These soldiers had gone into battle.
Eleazar said, “This is the rule of the law.
The LORD gave this command to Moses.
You must purify certain things.
Take the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead.
These metals can withstand fire.
You must put them through the fire.
Then they will be clean.
But you must also purify them with the water of purification.
If something cannot withstand fire, do not put it in the fire.
You must pass it through water to purify it.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל־ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֔א הַבָּאִ֖ים לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ אַ֥ךְ אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֖ב וְאֶת־ הַכָּ֑סֶף אֶֽת־ הַנְּחֹ֙שֶׁת֙ אֶת־ הַבַּרְזֶ֔ל אֶֽת־ הַבְּדִ֖יל וְאֶת־ הָעֹפָֽרֶת׃ כָּל־ דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־ יָבֹ֣א בָאֵ֗שׁ תַּעֲבִ֤ירוּ בָאֵשׁ֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר אַ֕ךְ בְּמֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה יִתְחַטָּ֑א וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יָבֹ֛א בָּאֵ֖שׁ תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ בַמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: On the seventh day you are to wash your clothes, and you will be clean. After that you may enter the camp.”
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the soldiers who returned from battle.
He told them to wash their clothes on the seventh day.
After they washed their clothes, they would be clean.
Then they could enter the camp.
passages.original: וְכִבַּסְתֶּ֧ם בִּגְדֵיכֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖י וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם וְאַחַ֖ר תָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃פ

passages.text: The LORD said to Moses, “You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Moses must act with Eleazar the priest.
Moses must also act with the heads of the families of the congregation.
They must count all that was captured.
They must count both people and animals.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ שָׂ֗א אֵ֣ת רֹ֤אשׁ מַלְק֙וֹחַ֙ הַשְּׁבִ֔י בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְאֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאשֵׁ֖י אֲב֥וֹת הָעֵדָֽה׃

passages.text: Then divide the captives between the troops who went out to battle and the rest of the congregation.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions about the captives and the spoils of war.
Some men went out to battle as soldiers.
Other people stayed in the camp as the rest of the congregation.
God told Moses to divide the captives and the spoils.
Moses must split them between the soldiers who fought in the battle and the rest of the congregation.
passages.original: וְחָצִ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־ הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ בֵּ֚ין תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א וּבֵ֖ין כָּל־ הָעֵדָֽה׃

passages.text: Set aside a tribute for the LORD from what belongs to the soldiers who went into battle: one out of every five hundred, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, or sheep.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to set aside a tribute.
This tribute is for the LORD.
The tribute must come from the soldiers.
These soldiers went into battle.
Take one out of every five hundred.
This applies to persons.
This applies to cattle.
This applies to donkeys.
This applies to sheep.
passages.original: וַהֲרֵמֹתָ֨ מֶ֜כֶס לַֽיהוָ֗ה מֵאֵ֞ת אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים לַצָּבָ֔א אֶחָ֣ד נֶ֔פֶשׁ מֵחֲמֵ֖שׁ הַמֵּא֑וֹת מִן־ הָאָדָם֙ וּמִן־ הַבָּקָ֔ר וּמִן־ הַחֲמֹרִ֖ים וּמִן־ הַצֹּֽאן׃

passages.text: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses led the people of Israel.
God gave Moses instructions.
The soldiers went to battle and took plunder.
God told Moses to divide the plunder in half.
One half belonged to the soldiers.
From the soldiers’ half, take a portion.
Give this portion to Eleazar the priest.
This portion is an offering to the LORD.
passages.original: מִמַּֽחֲצִיתָ֖ם תִּקָּ֑חוּ וְנָתַתָּ֛ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַכֹּהֵ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: From the Israelites’ half, take one out of every fifty, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep, or other animals, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to Moses for the Israelites.
The Israelites had taken plunder from battle.
God told Moses to divide the plunder in half.
One half belonged to the Israelites who did not go to war.
From this half, Moses must take a portion.
Moses must take one out of every fifty.
This applies to people, cattle, donkeys, sheep, and all other animals.
Moses must give these to the Levites.
The Levites care for the tabernacle of the LORD.
The Levites guard and serve at the LORD’s tabernacle.
passages.original: וּמִמַּחֲצִ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּקַּ֣ח׀ אֶחָ֣ד׀ אָחֻ֣ז מִן־ הַחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים מִן־ הָאָדָ֧ם מִן־ הַבָּקָ֛ר מִן־ הַחֲמֹרִ֥ים וּמִן־ הַצֹּ֖אן מִכָּל־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתָם֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֕י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD had commanded Moses, and this plunder remained from the spoils the soldiers had taken: 675,000 sheep, 72,000 cattle, 61,000 donkeys, and 32,000 women who had not slept with a man.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Eleazar was the priest.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Moses and Eleazar obeyed the LORD’s command.
The soldiers of Israel took spoils in battle.
Some of the plunder remained after the battle.
The plunder included 675,000 sheep.
The plunder included 72,000 cattle.
The plunder included 61,000 donkeys.
The plunder included 32,000 women.
These women had not slept with a man.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ וַיְהִי֙ הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ יֶ֣תֶר הַבָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּזְז֖וּ עַ֣ם הַצָּבָ֑א צֹ֗אן שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵֽשֶׁת־ אֲלָפִֽים׃ וּבָקָ֕ר שְׁנַ֥יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים אֶחָ֥ד וְשִׁשִּׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם מִן־ הַ֨נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר כָּל־ נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁנַ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: This was the half portion for those who had gone to war: 337,500 sheep, including a tribute to the LORD of 675, 36,000 cattle, including a tribute to the LORD of 72, 30,500 donkeys, including a tribute to the LORD of 61, and 16,000 people, including a tribute to the LORD of 32.
passages.sermon:
The people who went to war received half of the plunder.
Their share included 337,500 sheep.
From these sheep, they gave 675 as a tribute to the LORD.
Their share also included 36,000 cattle.
From these cattle, they gave 72 as a tribute to the LORD.
Their share included 30,500 donkeys.
From these donkeys, they gave 61 as a tribute to the LORD.
Their share included 16,000 people.
From these people, they gave 32 as a tribute to the LORD.
passages.original: וַתְּהִי֙ הַֽמֶּחֱצָ֔ה חֵ֕לֶק הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים בַּצָּבָ֑א מִסְפַּ֣ר הַצֹּ֗אן שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְשִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ וַיְהִ֛י הַמֶּ֥כֶס לַֽיהוָ֖ה מִן־ הַצֹּ֑אן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָמֵ֥שׁ וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃ וְהַ֨בָּקָ֔ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּמִכְסָ֥ם לַיהוָ֖ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְשִׁבְעִֽים׃ וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וּמִכְסָ֥ם לַֽיהוָ֖ה אֶחָ֥ד וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃ וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וּמִכְסָם֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים נָֽפֶשׁ׃

passages.text: Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest as an offering for the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Eleazar was the priest.
The LORD had given Moses a command.
Moses obeyed the LORD.
Moses took the tribute.
Moses gave the tribute to Eleazar the priest.
This tribute was an offering for the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶת־ מֶ֙כֶס֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: From the Israelites’ half, which Moses had set apart from the men who had gone to war, this half belonged to the congregation: 337,500 sheep, 36,000 cattle, 30,500 donkeys, and 16,000 people.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses set apart a half portion from the Israelites.
This half was separate from the men who had gone to war.
This half belonged to the congregation of Israel.
The congregation’s half included 337,500 sheep.
It included 36,000 cattle.
It included 30,500 donkeys.
It included 16,000 people.
passages.original: וּמִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ חָצָ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן־ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַצֹּבְאִֽים׃ וַתְּהִ֛י מֶחֱצַ֥ת הָעֵדָ֖ה מִן־ הַצֹּ֑אן שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ וּבָקָ֕ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ וַחֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃ וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: From the Israelites’ half, Moses took one out of every fifty persons and animals and gave them to the Levites who kept charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The Israelites had taken spoils from war.
Moses divided the spoils into two halves.
One half belonged to the Israelites who did not go to war.
From this half, Moses took a portion.
He took one out of every fifty persons.
He also took one out of every fifty animals.
Moses gave these people and animals to the Levites.
The Levites were responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the LORD.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִמַּחֲצִ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־ הָֽאָחֻז֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־ הַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים מִן־ הָאָדָ֖ם וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתָ֜ם לַלְוִיִּ֗ם שֹֽׁמְרֵי֙ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Then the officers who were over the units of the army—the commanders of thousands and of hundreds—approached Moses and said, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one of us is missing.
passages.sermon:
The officers led the army units.
These officers commanded thousands and hundreds of soldiers.
They approached Moses.
They spoke to Moses.
They said, “Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command.
Not one man is missing.”
passages.original: וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַפְּקֻדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַלְפֵ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ נָֽשְׂא֗וּ אֶת־ רֹ֛אשׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֵ֑נוּ וְלֹא־ נִפְקַ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: So we have brought to the LORD an offering of the gold articles each man acquired—armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The commanders of the army spoke to Moses.
They said, “We have brought an offering to the LORD.
Each man found gold articles among the plunder.
These gold articles include armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces.
We bring these items to the LORD.
We do this to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.”
passages.original: וַנַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־ קָרְבַּ֣ן יְהוָ֗ה אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א כְלִֽי־ זָהָב֙ אֶצְעָדָ֣ה וְצָמִ֔יד טַבַּ֖עַת עָגִ֣יל וְכוּמָ֑ז לְכַפֵּ֥ר עַל־ נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖ינוּ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: So Moses and Eleazar the priest received from them all the articles made out of gold.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Eleazar was the priest of Israel.
The commanders of the army brought gold articles.
These gold articles were made by hand.
Moses and Eleazar received all these gold articles from the commanders.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֖ב מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם כֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י מַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: All the gold that the commanders of thousands and of hundreds presented as an offering to the LORD weighed 16,750 shekels.
passages.sermon: The commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds brought an offering to the LORD.\r\nThey gave gold as their offering.\r\nThe total weight of the gold was 16,750 shekels.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כָּל־ זְהַ֣ב הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵרִ֙ימוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף שְׁבַע־ מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁ֑קֶל מֵאֵת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמֵאֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Each of the soldiers had taken plunder for himself.
passages.sermon: The soldiers took plunder.\r\nEach soldier took plunder for himself.
passages.original: אַנְשֵׁי֙ הַצָּבָ֔א בָּזְז֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And Moses and Eleazar the priest received the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and brought it into the Tent of Meeting as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Eleazar was the priest of Israel.
The commanders of thousands and of hundreds gave gold.
Moses and Eleazar received the gold from these commanders.
Moses and Eleazar brought the gold into the Tent of Meeting.
They placed the gold there as a memorial for the Israelites.
They set it before the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֔ב מֵאֵ֛ת שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְהַמֵּא֑וֹת וַיָּבִ֤אוּ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד זִכָּר֥וֹן לִבְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
